Unit 9: Segmentation & Sizing

Before you can position a product, enable a sales team, or run a campaign, you need to answer a deceptively simple question: who are we going after?

This unit introduces three segmentation lenses:

Category-Competition Matrix
Emerging vs. Established × Fragmented vs. Consolidated
Growth Quadrant Analysis
Stars, Question Marks, Cash Cows, Dogs—where to invest vs. harvest
TAM/SAM/SOM with AI
Build defensible market models in hours, not weeks
